# Claude Code Skills: Locations and Loading

Claude Code loads skills from several folders, and a skill with the same name in a higher place wins.
The places, the name rules, and the old `.claude/commands/` folder are listed below.
For example, `~/.claude/skills/review/SKILL.md` gives a `/review` skill in each project.
The marks are explained on [Skills and Commands](Claude-Code-Skills-And-Commands).

## Skill Locations

| Mark | Item | What It Does | How It Works | Where It Can Be Used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | Enterprise skill `<managed dir>/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Skills for all users on a machine. | Wins over personal and project skills of the same name. | All sessions on the machine. | [Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | Personal skill `~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Skills for all your projects. | Wins over project skills. | Local sessions. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | Project skill `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Skills for one repository. | Loaded from the start directory and each parent up to the repository root. A linked worktree without `.claude/skills` uses the main checkout (v2.1.277 or later). | Sessions in the repository. | - |
| ✅ | Nested `.claude/skills/` below the start directory | Skills for a sub-project. | Loads when Claude first reads or edits a file there, or after `/add-dir <subdir>`. A clash gives `/apps/web:deploy` for the nested one. | Sessions in a monorepo. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | `--add-dir` or `/add-dir` directory | Skills, `commands/`, and `agents/` of another directory. | `permissions.additionalDirectories` grants file access only and loads none of these. Needs the `project` setting source. | Local sessions. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | Plugin `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Skills of a plugin. | Command name is `/<plugin>:<skill>`. A plugin root `SKILL.md` with no `skills/` loads as one skill. See [Plugins Manifest](Claude-Code-Plugins-Manifest). | Plugin sessions. | - |
| ✅ | Synced skills `~/.claude/skills/synced/` | Skills enabled on your claude.ai account. | Downloaded in the background (v2.1.273 or later). Checked about each 10 minutes while active, about each 40 minutes while idle. Never uploaded. Name `anthropic-skills` is reserved. | claude.ai sign-in only. Not in bare mode or `--safe-mode`. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | Trash `~/.claude/skills/.trash/` | Holds removed synced skills. | A retention sweep deletes entries (30 days by default). | Local. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| 🔍 | MCP-served skill | A skill served by an MCP server. | Bundle text: "This skill is served by MCP server ... call ... with server and uri". Supporting files are read through MCP resources. The `loadedFrom` value is `mcp`. | Sessions with that MCP server. | bundle `loadedFrom:"mcp"` |
| 🔍 | Skill `loadedFrom` values | Internal origin tags. | Found: `skills`, `commands_DEPRECATED`, `plugin`, `bundled`, `syncedSkills`, `mcp`, `memoryStore`. | Internal. | bundle |
| ✅ | `<name>@skills-dir` plugin | A plugin made by `claude plugin init` in `~/.claude/skills/<name>/`. | Loads with no install step. Marketplace name `skills-dir` is reserved. | Local. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Plugin Loading Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/loading) |

## Name Resolution

| Mark | Item | What It Does | How It Works | Where It Can Be Used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | Clash order | Picks the skill that `/name` runs. | Enterprise, then personal, then project. A skill replaces a bundled skill or a built-in command of the same name but not its aliases. A skill wins over a `.claude/commands/` file. | All. | [Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | Name from layout | Sets the command name. | `.claude/commands/frontend/component.md` is `/frontend:component`. Frontmatter `name` sets the name of a skill directory. A plugin `name` sets the last segment. | All. | [Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | Refused characters | Protects the `/` menu. | Refused: zero-width, control, private-use, bidirectional, odd blanks, `<`, `>`. Debug log tag `[names]`. | All. | [Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| 🔍 | Name length | Caps a frontmatter `name`. | Longer than 256 characters: ignored with a warning. The same check also refuses names with `<`, `>`, or control characters. | All. | bundle `Frontmatter "name" of ... is over` |

## Custom Commands

| Mark | Item | What It Does | How It Works | Where It Can Be Used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `.claude/commands/<name>.md` and `~/.claude/commands/` | The old form of a skill. | Same as a skill. Accepts the same frontmatter except `name` and `paths`. Subfolders become `:` segments. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | Plugin `commands` map | Commands from a manifest. | Keys `source` or `content`, `description`, `argumentHint`, `model`, `allowedTools`. | Plugins. | - |
| ✅ | Live change detection | Reloads `SKILL.md` text. | Not in bare mode. A new top-level skills directory needs `/reload-skills`. Changes to `hooks/`, `.mcp.json`, `agents/`, `output-styles/` need `/reload-plugins`. | Local. | [Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | Skill listing budget | Caps skill text in context. | 1 percent of the window (`skillListingBudgetFraction`). Each entry has 1,536 characters (`skillListingMaxDescChars`). Env `SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET` sets a fixed count. | All. | [Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `--disable-slash-commands` | Turns off all skills. | CLI flag. Help text: "Disable all skills". | CLI. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ✅ | Settings `skillOverrides` | Per-skill visibility. | `on`, `name-only`, `user-invocable-only`, `off`. Plugin skills are not affected. | Settings. | [Commands](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/commands), [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | Settings `disableBundledSkills` | Removes bundled skills. | Equals env `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS=1`. Built-in commands stay typable. | Settings. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | Env `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_POLICY_SKILLS`, `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_API_SKILL`, `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE_SKILL`, `CLAUDE_CODE_SKILL_PROPOSALS`, `CLAUDE_CODE_SKILL_ATTRIBUTION` | Skill-related env names. | Found in the env inventory. | Unknown | [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) |
